1, objScenarioType, wftim.XFConvertToInt()) If flowtext1.Contains("|") Then stringlist.Add("F#" & Item.Member.Name & ",") Else Continue For End If Next stringlist.Sort() If stringlist.Count = 0 Return " " Else Dim FinalString As String = String.Join(",", stringlist) Dim UpdatedMemberInfo As List(Of MemberInfo) = api.Members.GetMembersUsingFilter(args.MemberListArgs.DimPk, FinalString, Nothing) Dim listList As New MemberList(listHeader, UpdatedMemberInfo) Return listList End If End If
Else 'user is an not an admin so return a list based on their DataAccessSecurity 'First, get a dictionary of their security parent group they are assigned to Dim userParentGroupsDict As Dictionary(Of Guid, Group) = BRApi.Security.Authorization.GetUser(si, objUserName).ParentGroups
' Next - Loop through the list Of data access groups To see If their parent Group matches, And If so, add the member filter From that Group To the member list Dim objCube As Cube = api.Cubes.GetCubeOrReferencedCubeForDataAccess(api.Pov.Cube.CubeId, api.Pov.EntityDim.DimPk.DimId) Dim CubeDataCellAccessItems As List(Of CubeDataAccessItem) = objCube.CubeDataCellAccessItems For Each Item As CubeDataAccessItem In CubeDataCellAccessItems If userParentGroupsDict.ContainsKey(Item.GroupUniqueID) Dim cubeMemberFilter As String = Item.GetCombinedMemberFilterString ' Only Return a value If it starts With F# To make sure its a flow specific dimension data access item ' If cube member filter contains '.Where(Text8 DoesNotContain '_WV') user does not have working version access so only return Non-WV RPs If (cubeMemberFilter.StartsWith("F#") And cubeMemberFilter.Contains(".Where(Name DoesNotContain '_WV')")) If SearchQuery = "" Then Dim listHeader As New MemberListHeader(args.MemberListArgs.MemberListName) Dim listInfos As List(Of MemberInfo) = api.Members.GetMembersUsingFilter(args.MemberListArgs.DimPk, MemberFilterScriptWF & ".Where(Text8 Contains [_" & Appropriation & "_])", Nothing) For Each value In listInfos Dim flowtext1 As String = api.Flow.Text(value.Member.MemberId, 1, objScenarioType, wftim.XFConvertToInt()) If flowtext1.Contains("|") Then stringlist.Add("F#" & value.Member.Name & ",") End If Next stringlist.Sort() If stringlist.Count = 0 Return " " Else Dim FinalString As String = String.Join(",", stringlist) Dim UpdatedMemberInfo As List(Of MemberInfo) = api.Members.GetMembersUsingFilter(args.MemberListArgs.DimPk, FinalString, Nothing) Dim listList As New MemberList(listHeader, UpdatedMemberInfo) Return listList End If Else Dim listHeader As New MemberListHeader(args.MemberListArgs.MemberListName) Dim listInfos As List(Of MemberInfo) = api.Members.GetMembersUsingFilter(args.MemberListArgs.DimPk, MemberFilterScriptWF & ".Where((Text8 Contains [_" & Appropriation & "_]) AND ((Text8 Contains [" & SearchQuery & "]) Or (Description Contains [" & SearchQuery & "])))" , Nothing) For Each value In listInfos Dim flowtext1 As String = api.Flow.Text(value.Member.MemberId, 1, objScenarioType, wftim.XFConvertToInt()) If flowtext1.Contains("|") Then stringlist.Add("F#" & value.Member.Name & ",") End If Next stringlist.Sort() If stringlist.Count = 0 Return " " Else Dim FinalString As String = String.Join(",", stringlist) Dim UpdatedMemberInfo As List(Of MemberInfo) = api.Members.GetMembersUsingFilter(args.MemberListArgs.DimPk, FinalString, Nothing) Dim listList As New MemberList(listHeader, UpdatedMemberInfo) Return listList End If End If ' user has access To all flow members so just Return the regular list Else If cubeMemberFilter.StartsWith("F#") If SearchQuery = "" Then Dim listHeader As New MemberListHeader(args.MemberListArgs.MemberListName) Dim listInfos As List(Of MemberInfo) = api.Members.GetMembersUsingFilter(args.MemberListArgs.DimPk, MemberFilterScriptWF & ".Where(Text8 Contains [_" & Appropriation & "_])," & MemberFilterScriptWF_WV & ".Where(Text8 Contains [_" & Appropriation & "_])", Nothing) For Each value In listInfos Dim flowtext1 As String = api.Flow.Text(value.Member.MemberId, 1, objScenarioType, wftim.XFConvertToInt()) If flowtext1.Contains("|") Then stringlist.Add("F#" & value.Member.Name & ",") End If Next stringlist.Sort() If stringlist.Count = 0 Return " " Else Dim FinalString As String = String.Join(",", stringlist) Dim UpdatedMemberInfo As List(Of MemberInfo) = api.Members.GetMembersUsingFilter(args.MemberListArgs.DimPk, FinalString, Nothing) Dim listList As New MemberList(listHeader, UpdatedMemberInfo) Return listList End If Else Dim listHeader As New MemberListHeader(args.MemberListArgs.MemberListName) Dim listInfos As List(Of MemberInfo) = api.Members.GetMembersUsingFilter(args.MemberListArgs.DimPk, MemberFilterScriptWF & ".Where((Text8 Contains [_" & Appropriation & "_]) AND ((Text8 Contains [" & SearchQuery & "]) Or (Description Contains [" & SearchQuery & "])))," & MemberFilterScriptWF_WV & ".Where((Text8 Contains [_" & Appropriation & "_]) AND ((Text8 Contains [" & SearchQuery & "]) Or (Description Contains [" & SearchQuery & "])))" , Nothing) For Each value In listInfos Dim flowtext1 As String = api.Flow.Text(value.Member.MemberId, 1, objScenarioType, wftim.XFConvertToInt()) If flowtext1.Contains("|") Then stringlist.Add("F#" & value.Member.Name & ",") End If Next stringlist.Sort() If stringlist.Count = 0 Return " " Else Dim FinalString As String = String.Join(",", stringlist) Dim UpdatedMemberInfo As List(Of MemberInfo) = api.Members.GetMembersUsingFilter(args.MemberListArgs.DimPk, FinalString, Nothing) Dim listList As New MemberList(listHeader, UpdatedMemberInfo) Return listList End If End If End If End If Next
End If End If End If #End Region
#Region "GETRPPOA" If args.MemberListArgs.MemberListName.XFEqualsIgnoreCase("GETRPPOA") Then
Dim wfYearYY As String = api.Workflow.GetWorkflowUnitInfo.TimeName.Substring(2,2) Dim flowDimPk As DimPk = api.Dimensions.GetDim("Std_Flow").DimPk
Dim filterRP As String = "F#FY" & wfYearYY & "_RP.Base"
Dim rpListInfos As List(Of MemberInfo) = api.Members.GetMembersUsingFilter(flowDimPk, filterRP, Nothing)
If Not rpListInfos Is Nothing Then Return New MemberList(New MemberListHeader(args.MemberListArgs.MemberListName), rpListInfos) End If End If
Return Nothing #End Region
End Select
Return Nothing Catch ex As Exception Throw ErrorHandler.LogWrite(si, New XFException(si, ex)) End Try End Function
Private Function BuildBilletFilter(ByVal startNum As Integer, ByVal endNum As Integer) As String Dim sb As New System.Text.StringBuilder For i As Integer = startNum To endNum If i > 9 Then sb.Append("U6#LineItem_" & i & ",") Else sb.Append("U6#LineItem_0" & i & ",") End If Next Dim result As String = sb.ToString If result.Length > 0 Then result = result.Remove(result.Length - 1) End If Return result End Function
End Class End Namespace

Imports System Imports System.Collections.Generic Imports System.Data Imports System.Data.Common Imports System.Globalization Imports System.IO Imports System.Linq Imports System.Windows.Forms Imports Microsoft.VisualBasic Imports OneStream.Finance.Database Imports OneStream.Finance.Engine Imports OneStream.Shared.Common Imports OneStream.Shared.Database Imports OneStream.Shared.Engine Imports OneStream.Shared.Wcf Imports OneStream.Stage.Database Imports OneStream.Stage.Engine
Namespace OneStream.BusinessRule.Finance.USCG_BudFm_Utilities Public Class MainClass
'*********************************************EDITING TRACKER************************************************************ '***************************FILL OUT EVERY TIME YOU ARE EDITING RULE, AND SAVE IMMEDIATELY******************************* '*********************DO NOT FORGET TO CHANGE YOUR STATUS TO CLOSED AND SAVE RULE BEFORE YOU EXIT************************
'Name: Monica N. 'Date: 07/31/2024 'Time: 03:26 PM 'Open/Closed: Closed ' '************************************************************************************************************************ #Region "Class Variables"
' These are available to all the functions in this business rule Public Dim rpUtils As New OneStream.BusinessRule.extender.BudFm_RP_Utilities.MainClass
#End Region 'Class Variables
Public Function Main(ByVal si As SessionInfo, ByVal globals As BRGlobals, ByVal api As FinanceRulesApi, ByVal args As FinanceRulesArgs) As Object Try Select Case api.FunctionType
Case Is = FinanceFunctionType.CustomCalculate
#Region "GetRPAttributes"
If args.CustomCalculateArgs.FunctionName.XFEqualsIgnoreCase("GetRPAttributes") Then Dim scriptGenerics As String = globals.GetStringValue("scriptGenerics") 'Get the POV variables from script Generics. We have to ensure the script generics being passed in is in the same order in each place it is used Dim dimensions As List(Of String) = StringHelper.SplitString(scriptGenerics,":") Dim entity As String = dimensions(0).Replace("E#","") Dim scenario As String = dimensions(1).Replace("S#","") Dim time As String = dimensions(2).Replace("T#","") Dim flow As String = dimensions(4).Replace("F#","") Dim ud6 As String = dimensions(12).Replace("U6#","") Dim ud8 As String = dimensions(14).Replace("U8#","")
Dim parAccount As String = globals.GetStringValue("parAccount") Dim parAccountId As Integer = api.Members.GetMemberId(dimtypeid.Account, parAccount) Dim budFm_AccountDimPk As DimPk = api.Dimensions.GetDim("BudFm_Account").DimPk Dim accountBaseList = api.Members.GetMembersUsingFilter(budFm_AccountDimPk,parAccount) Dim attributeDict As New Dictionary(Of String, String)
Dim accountBuilder As New Text.StringBuilder For Each baseAccount As MemberInfo In accountBaseList accountBuilder.Append("'" & baseAccount.Member.Name & "',") Next
'remove the last comma accountBuilder.Remove(accountBuilder.ToString.Length -1,1)
'Create the SQL Statement Dim sql As New Text.StringBuilder sql.AppendLine("WITH RankedData AS (") sql.AppendLine(" SELECT Account, [Text], Origin,") ' Assign priority: Forms = 1 (Top), Import = 2, everything else = 3 sql.AppendLine(" ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY Account ORDER BY ") sql.AppendLine(" CASE WHEN Origin = 'Forms' AND [Text] <> '' THEN 1 ") sql.AppendLine(" WHEN Origin = 'Import' AND [Text] <> '' THEN 2 ") sql.AppendLine(" ELSE 3 END ASC) as PriorityRank") sql.AppendLine(" FROM dbo.DataAttachment") sql.AppendLine(" WHERE Cube = 'BudFm'") sql.AppendFormat(" AND [Time] = '{0}' ", time) sql.AppendFormat(" AND Scenario = '{0}' ", scenario) sql.AppendFormat(" AND Entity = '{0}' ", entity) sql.AppendFormat(" AND Flow = '{0}' ", flow) sql.AppendLine(" AND UD6 = '" & ud6 & "'") sql.AppendLine(" AND UD8 = '" & ud8 & "'") sql.AppendLine(" AND Account IN (" & accountBuilder.ToString & ")") sql.AppendLine(")") sql.AppendLine("SELECT Account, [Text], Origin") sql.AppendLine("FROM RankedData") sql.AppendLine("WHERE PriorityRank = 1") ' This pulls ONLY the top priority row
Dim dt As New DataTable Using dbConnApp As DbConnInfo = BRApi.Database.CreateApplicationDbConnInfo(si) dt = BRApi.Database.ExecuteSql(dbConnApp, sql.ToString, True) End Using BRApi.ErrorLog.LogMessage(si,$"Hit this RP ATT {scriptGenerics} - {parAccount} - {sql.ToString} - {dt.Rows.COunt}") For Each dtRow As DataRow In dt.Rows
attributeDict.Add(dtRow("Account"), dtRow("Text"))
Next
globals.SetObject("attributeDict", attributeDict)
End If #End Region
#Region "GetSingleRPAttribute"
If args.CustomCalculateArgs.FunctionName.XFEqualsIgnoreCase("GetSingleRPAttribute") Then Dim memberScript As String = globals.GetStringValue("memberScript") Dim attributeValueDataAttachmentList As DataAttachmentList = api.Data.GetDataAttachments(memberScript, False) Dim attributeValue As String = String.Empty For Each attributeValueDataAttachment As DataAttachment In attributeValueDataAttachmentList.Items attributeValue = attributeValueDataAttachment.Text Next
globals.SetStringValue("attributeValue", attributeValue)
End If #End Region
#Region "Get_RP_Status_Description"
If args.CustomCalculateArgs.FunctionName.XFEqualsIgnoreCase("Get_RP_Status_Description") Then Return Get_RP_Status_Description(si, api.Pov.Flow.Name)
End If #End Region #Region "Get_RP_Mode_Description"
If args.CustomCalculateArgs.FunctionName.XFEqualsIgnoreCase("Get_RP_Mode_Description") Then Return Get_RP_Mode_Description(si, api.Pov.Flow.Name)
End If #End Region #Region "Get_RP_CC_Required_Description"
If args.CustomCalculateArgs.FunctionName.XFEqualsIgnoreCase("Get_RP_CC_Required_Description") Then Return Get_RP_CC_Required_Description(si, api.Pov.Flow.Name)
End If #End Region
#Region "DefaultNo"
If args.CustomCalculateArgs.FunctionName.XFEqualsIgnoreCase("DefaultNo") Then
Dim wfCube As String = api.Pov.Time.Name Dim RPName As String = api.Pov.Flow.Name Dim RP_Entity As String = api.Pov.Entity.Name Dim wfScenario As String = args.CustomCalculateArgs.NameValuePairs.XFGetValue("wfScenario") Dim wfTime As String = args.CustomCalculateArgs.NameValuePairs.XFGetValue("wfTime")
Dim NoValue As Integer = 0
Dim numOfBillets As Integer = api.Data.GetDataCellEx("A#Number_of_Billets:E#" & RP_Entity & ":S#" & wfScenario & ":T#" & wfTime & ":V#Annotation:F#" & RPName & ":O#Forms:I#None:U1#None:U2#None:U3#None:U4#None:U5#None:U6#None:U7#None:U8#None").DataCellAnnotation.XFConvertToInt
Dim billetDeleteString = ""
For i As Int32 = 1 To numOfBillets
Dim billetNum As String = "" If i < 10 Then billetNum = "LineItem_0" & i.ToString
Else billetNum = "LineItem_" & i.ToString
End If
Dim scriptGenerics As String = "Cb#" & wfCube & ":E#" & RP_Entity & ":S#" & wfScenario & ":T#" & wfTime & ":V#Periodic:F#" & RPName & ":O#Forms:I#None:U1#None:U2#None:U3#None:U4#None:U5#None:U6#" & billetNum & ":U7#None:U8#None"
api.Data.Calculate("A#Billets_Yes_No_Input:V#Periodic:F#" & RPName &":V#Periodic:O#Forms:I#None:U1#None:U2#None:U3#None:U4#None:U5#None:U6#" & billetNum & ":U7#None:U8#None = (0)",,,,,,,,,,,,,,,True)
Next
End If
#End Region
#Region "GetCostEstimateTable" If args.CustomCalculateArgs.FunctionName.XFEqualsIgnoreCase("GetCostEstimateTable") Then
'Get time variable Dim wfTime As String = api.Pov.Time.Name Dim wfScenario As String = api.Pov.Scenario.Name Dim wfYY As String = wfTime.Substring(2,2)
'Do not run in wfYY < 26 as these would be historical data years If wfYY.XFConvertToInt < 26 Then Return Nothing
#Region "Table Columns" Dim dtCEDR As New DataTable("CEDR") Dim objColCEDR As DataColumn = New DataColumn
objColCEDR = New DataColumn objColCEDR.ColumnName = "RP" objColCEDR.DataType = GetType(String) objColCEDR.DefaultValue = "" objColCEDR.AllowDBNull = False dtCEDR.Columns.Add(objColCEDR)
objColCEDR = New DataColumn objColCEDR.ColumnName = "PPA" objColCEDR.DataType = GetType(String) objColCEDR.DefaultValue = "" objColCEDR.AllowDBNull = False dtCEDR.Columns.Add(objColCEDR)
objColCEDR = New DataColumn objColCEDR.ColumnName = "UII" objColCEDR.DataType = GetType(String) objColCEDR.DefaultValue = "" objColCEDR.AllowDBNull = False dtCEDR.Columns.Add(objColCEDR)
objColCEDR = New DataColumn objColCEDR.ColumnName = "Object_Class" objColCEDR.DataType = GetType(String) objColCEDR.DefaultValue = "" objColCEDR.AllowDBNull = False dtCEDR.Columns.Add(objColCEDR)
objColCEDR = New DataColumn objColCEDR.ColumnName = "ATU" objColCEDR.DataType = GetType(String) objColCEDR.DefaultValue = "" objColCEDR.AllowDBNull = False dtCEDR.Columns.Add(objColCEDR)
objColCEDR = New DataColumn objColCEDR.ColumnName = "Cost_Line" objColCEDR.DataType = GetType(String) objColCEDR.DefaultValue = "" objColCEDR.AllowDBNull = False dtCEDR.Columns.Add(objColCEDR)
objColCEDR = New DataColumn objColCEDR.ColumnName = "Unique" objColCEDR.DataType = GetType(String) objColCEDR.DefaultValue = "" objColCEDR.AllowDBNull = False dtCEDR.Columns.Add(objColCEDR)
objColCEDR = New DataColumn objColCEDR.ColumnName = "Recurring_Non_Recurring" objColCEDR.DataType = GetType(String) objColCEDR.DefaultValue = "" objColCEDR.AllowDBNull = False dtCEDR.Columns.Add(objColCEDR)
objColCEDR = New DataColumn objColCEDR.ColumnName = "Mod_Name" objColCEDR.DataType = GetType(String) objColCEDR.DefaultValue = "" objColCEDR.AllowDBNull = False dtCEDR.Columns.Add(objColCEDR)
objColCEDR = New DataColumn objColCEDR.ColumnName = "Winning_Quarter" objColCEDR.DataType = GetType(String) objColCEDR.DefaultValue = "" objColCEDR.AllowDBNull = False dtCEDR.Columns.Add(objColCEDR)
objColCEDR = New DataColumn objColCEDR.ColumnName = "Total_AnnTerm" objColCEDR.DataType = GetType(Decimal) objColCEDR.DefaultValue = 0 objColCEDR.AllowDBNull = False dtCEDR.Columns.Add(objColCEDR)
objColCEDR = New DataColumn objColCEDR.ColumnName = "New_Requested_Funding" objColCEDR.DataType = GetType(Decimal) objColCEDR.DefaultValue = 0 objColCEDR.AllowDBNull = False dtCEDR.Columns.Add(objColCEDR)
objColCEDR = New DataColumn objColCEDR.ColumnName = "Scaled_Funding" objColCEDR.DataType = GetType(Decimal) objColCEDR.DefaultValue = 0 objColCEDR.AllowDBNull = False dtCEDR.Columns.Add(objColCEDR)
#End Region
#Region "Table Rows and Buffer"
' Create a Default Row Dim defaultrow As DataRow = dtCEDR.NewRow() Dim defaultRP_Details As String = String.Empty
Dim mbrScriptBuilder As String = String.Empty
'Get the member list Of ATUs To Loop through Dim std_ATUDimPk As DimPk = api.Dimensions.GetDim("std_ATU").DimPk Dim total_ATUId As Integer = api.Members.GetMemberId(dimtypeId.UD4, "Total_ATU")
'Get the member list Of CostLines To Loop through Dim std_CostLineDimPk As DimPk = api.Dimensions.GetDim("std_CostLine").DimPk Dim costEstimate_RollupId As Integer = api.Members.GetMemberId(dimtypeId.UD5, "CostEstimate_Rollup")
'Declare variables to be used in the loops so we don't have to define them each time it loops below Dim startingBuffer As DataBuffer Dim msbFlowFilter As String = String.Empty Dim msbFlowFilterId As Integer Dim atuName As String = String.Empty Dim msbUD4 As String = String.Empty Dim msbUD4Len As Integer Dim msbUD4Filter As String = String.Empty Dim msbUD4FilterNameAndDescr As String = String.Empty Dim msbBufferUD5Id As Integer Dim msbBufferUD5Name As String = String.Empty Dim msbUD5Text6 As String = String.Empty Dim msbUD5Filter As String = String.Empty Dim msbUD5FilterNameAndDescr As String = String.Empty Dim costLineAncestors As New List(Of Member) Dim msbUD6Filter As String = String.Empty Dim msbUD7Filter As String = String.Empty Dim msbUD7FilterDescr As String = String.Empty Dim billet_CostLine As Member = api.Members.GetMember(DimTypeId.UD5, api.Members.GetMemberId(DimTypeId.UD5, "Billet_CostLine")) Dim ud5DimPk As DimPk = api.Dimensions.GetDim("std_CostLine").DimPk Dim r_NR As String = String.Empty Dim modQ As String = String.Empty Dim scaled_Funding As Decimal Dim new_Requested_Funding As Decimal Dim total_AnnTerm As Decimal Dim fundingScriptGenerics As String = String.Empty
'The purpose of this buffer is to filter through the RP members for the current WFYear where they are tagged in Text1 with Budget (Status_03) and only show RPs where Funding exists startingBuffer = api.Data.GetDataBufferUsingFormula("FilterMembers(RemoveZeros(T#" & wfTime & ":O#Top:I#Top:A#Funding), F#FY" & wfYY & "_RP.Base, U1#Total_Appropriations.Base, U2#Total_Investment.Base, U3#Total_ObjectClass.Base, U4#Total_ATU.Base, U5#CostEstimate_Rollup.Base, U6#Top_UD6_LineItem.Base)") 'startingBuffer.LogDataBuffer(api, "cost Estimate Detail Buffer", 10000) If Not startingBuffer Is Nothing Then
For Each startingCell As DataBufferCell In startingBuffer.DataBufferCells.Values If Not startingCell.CellStatus.IsNoData() Then 'only add Flow members to the list where Text1 contains Status_03 (Budget) msbFlowFilter = startingCell.GetFlowName(api) msbFlowFilterId = startingCell.DataBufferCellPk.FlowId If (api.Flow.Text(msbFlowFilterId,1).XFContainsIgnoreCase("Status_03"))
#Region "Get the entity from the RP"
Dim flowText8 As String = api.Flow.Text(msbFlowFilterId, 8, DimConstants.Unknown, DimConstants.Unknown) Dim rpfields As List (Of String) = Stringhelper.SplitString(flowText8, "_") Dim leadOffice As String = String.Empty Dim rpApprop As String = String.Empty
If rpfields.count > 4 leadOffice = "LO_" & rpfields(3) rpApprop = rpfields(4) End If
#End Region
#Region "Set the msbud4Filter"
'remove the _NoUnit in the UD4 member so that it only returns the parent member msbUD4 = startingCell.GetUD4Name(api) If (Not msbUD4.XFEqualsIgnoreCase("No_ATU")) msbUD4Len = msbUD4.Length msbUD4filter = msbUD4.Remove(msbUD4Len-7) 'remove the _NoUnit msbUD4FilterNameAndDescr = api.Members.GetMember(dimtypeid.UD4, "Std_Atu", msbUD4filter).NameAndDescription Else msbUD4filter = msbUD4 msbUD4FilterNameAndDescr = api.Members.GetMember(dimtypeid.UD4, "Std_Atu", msbUD4filter).NameAndDescription End If
#End Region
#Region "Set the msbud5Filter and Recurring/NonRecurring"
'Get the ancenstors of the buffer ud5 member and determine which one is a child of CostEstimate_Rollup and return that child for the member filter msbBufferUD5Name = startingCell.GetUD5Name(api) msbBufferUD5Id = startingCell.DataBufferCellPk.UD5Id costLineAncestors = api.Members.GetAncestors(std_CostLineDimPk, msbBufferUD5Id, False) msbUD6Filter = startingCell.GetUD6Name(api)
' 'If the RP is O&S (get the first two chars from PPA), then If (rpApprop = "OS" And costLineAncestors.Contains(billet_CostLine)) 'cost is a billet cost 'loop through the ancestors and determine which one is a child of CostEstimate_Rollup If Not costLineAncestors Is Nothing Then For Each costLineAncestor As Member In costLineAncestors If api.Members.IsChild(std_CostLineDimPk, costEstimate_RollupId, costLineAncestor.MemberId) msbUD5Filter = costLineAncestor.Name msbUD5FilterNameAndDescr = costLineAncestor.NameAndDescription 'Get the Recurring/Non-Recurring r_NR = api.UD5.Text(costLineAncestor.MemberId, 7) Else 'DoNothing End If Next Else msbUD5Filter = msbBufferUD5Name msbUD5FilterNameAndDescr = api.Members.GetMember(dimtypeid.UD5, startingCell.DataBufferCellPk.UD5Id).NameAndDescription End If Else If (rpApprop = "OS" And Not costLineAncestors.Contains(billet_CostLine)) 'cost is a cost estimate cost msbUD5Filter = msbBufferUD5Name 'check if UD5 member is a custom description member (>=4000) and if so, then return the custom description Dim msbUD5FilterSplit As List(Of String) = StringHelper.SplitString(msbUD5Filter, "_") Dim msbUD5FilterNum As Integer = msbUD5FilterSplit(0).XFConvertToInt If msbUD5FilterNum >=4000 Dim msbUD5CustDescr As String = api.Data.GetDataCellEx("E#" & leadOffice & ":C#Local:S#" & wfScenario & ":T#" & wfTime & ":V#Annotation:A#Description_Tier2_Input:F#" & msbFlowFilter & ":O#Forms:I#None:U1#None:U2#None:U3#None:U4#None:U5#" & msbUD5Filter & ":U6#" & msbUD6Filter & ":U7#None:U8#None").DataCellAnnotation msbUD5FilterNameAndDescr = msbUD5Filter & " - " & msbUD5CustDescr Else msbUD5FilterNameAndDescr = api.Members.GetMember(dimtypeid.UD5, startingCell.DataBufferCellPk.UD5Id).NameAndDescription End If 'If the UD5 is a cost estimate, check the account where recurring / Non recurring is stored 'R/NR cost estimate intersection: Cb#BudFm:E#LO_CG9:P#?:C#Local:S#RAP_FY25:T#2025:V#Annotation:A#R_NR:F#25_6000_00:O#Forms:I#None:U1#None:U2#None:U3#None:U4#None:U5#None:U6#NBLineItem_01:U7#None:U8#Annotation_Helper r_NR = api.Data.GetDataCellEx("E#" & leadOffice & ":C#Local:S#" & wfScenario & ":T#" & wfTime & ":V#Annotation:A#R_NR:F#" & msbFlowFilter & ":O#Forms:I#None:U1#None:U2#None:U3#None:U4#None:U5#None:U6#" & msbUD6Filter & ":U7#None:U8#None").DataCellAnnotation Else If (rpApprop = "PCI" Or rpApprop = "RD" Or rpApprop = "F") Then msbUD5Filter = msbBufferUD5Name msbUD5FilterNameAndDescr = api.Members.GetMember(dimtypeid.UD5, startingCell.DataBufferCellPk.UD5Id).NameAndDescription r_NR = "NR" Else msbUD5Filter = msbBufferUD5Name msbUD5FilterNameAndDescr = api.Members.GetMember(dimtypeid.UD5, startingCell.DataBufferCellPk.UD5Id).NameAndDescription r_NR = "R" End If
#End Region
#Region "Set the msbud6Filter" msbUD6Filter = startingCell.GetUD6Name(api)
#End Region
#Region "Set the msbud7Filter"
'Get the UD7 Unique name from the text 6 property on the bufferUD5 member and add the UNQ_ prefix and add it to the list msbUD5Text6 = api.UD5.Text(msbBufferUD5Id, 6) If (Not msbUD5Text6.Length = 0) msbUD7Filter = "UNQ_" & msbUD5Text6 msbUD7FilterDescr = api.Members.GetMember(dimtypeid.UD7, msbUD7Filter).Description Else msbud7Filter = "None" msbUD7FilterDescr = api.Members.GetMember(dimtypeid.UD7, msbUD7Filter).Description End If
#End Region
#Region "Get the Winning Quarter"
Dim scriptGenerics As String = "C#Local:V#Annotation:O#Forms:I#None:U1#None:U2#None:U3#None:U4#None:U5#None:U6#None:U7#None:U8#None" Dim OS_Qtrs As String = api.Data.GetDataCellEx("E#" & leadOffice & ":F#" & msbFlowFilter & ":A#OS_Qtrs:" & scriptGenerics).DataCellAnnotation Dim Pers_Qtrs As String = api.Data.GetDataCellEx("E#" & leadOffice & ":F#" & msbFlowFilter & ":A#Personnel_Qtrs:" & scriptGenerics).DataCellAnnotation
Dim qtrs_Type As String = api.UD5.Text(msbBufferUD5Id, 5, DimConstants.Unknown, DimConstants.Unknown)

If args.CustomCalculateArgs.FunctionName.XFEqualsIgnoreCase("AutoPopulateStaffSymbolsNew") Then 'wfCube - wfTime - wfScenario - wfProfile - RPAppr - RPName - RPEntity Dim wfCube As String = api.Pov.Cube.Name Dim wfTime As String = api.Pov.Time.Name '.XFConvertToInt() Dim wfTimeInt As Integer = wfTime.XFConvertToInt() Dim wfScenario As String = api.Pov.Scenario.Name Dim RPEntity As String = api.Pov.Entity.Name Dim wfProfile As String = globals.GetStringValue("WFProfile") Dim RPAppr As String = globals.GetStringValue("Appr") Dim RPName As String = globals.GetStringValue("Name")
'Create the initial list of existing Symbols using a buffer Dim symbolsbufferMbrScript As String = "A#StaffSymbol_ConcReview:F#" & RPName & ":O#Forms:I#None:U1#None:U2#None:U3#None:U4#None:U5#None:U6#None:U7#None" Dim symbolsBuffer As DataBuffer = api.Data.GetDataBufferUsingFormula("FilterMembers(" & symbolsbufferMbrScript & ", U8#Total_Comments.Base)") Dim maxCommentScriptGenerics As String = "E#" & RPEntity & ":S#" & wfScenario & ":T#" & wfTime & ":A#StaffSymbol_ConcReview:V#Annotation:F#" & RPName & ":C#Local:O#Forms:I#None:U1#None:U2#None:U3#None:U4#None:U5#None:U6#None:U7#None" Dim existingSymbols As New List(Of String) Dim symbol As String = String.Empty

Public Function GetAllOPFACsForAllBillets( ByVal si As SessionInfo, ByVal Cube As String, ByVal Entity As String, ByVal Scenario As String, ByVal Time As String, ByVal Flow As String)
Try #Region "GetAllOPFACsForAllBillets"
'"stuff" and "for xml path" are Microsoft T-SQL SQLSERVER functions that 'will concatenate the multiple OPFAC rows into one row and one column
Dim sqlStmt As New Text.StringBuilder sqlStmt.Append(" select stuff(' ,' + x.text,1,1,'') from ( ") sqlStmt.Append(" select distinct text ") sqlStmt.Append(" from dbo.DataAttachment ") sqlStmt.Append(" where Cube = '" & Cube & "' ") sqlStmt.Append(" and Time = '" & Time & "' ") sqlStmt.Append(" and Entity = '" & Entity & "' ") sqlStmt.Append(" and Flow = '" & Flow & "' ") sqlStmt.Append(" and Scenario = '" & Scenario & "' ") sqlStmt.Append(" and Account = 'OPFAC' ") sqlStmt.Append(" group by text ) x ") sqlStmt.Append(" order by 1 ") sqlStmt.Append(" for xml path('') ")
'BRApi.ErrorLog.LogMessage(si, "DZ--SQL---- " + sqlStmt.ToString)
Dim OPFAC_For_All_Billets As String = String.Empty Dim dt As New DataTable Using dbConnApp As DbConnInfo = BRApi.Database.CreateApplicationDbConnInfo(si) dt = BRApi.Database.ExecuteSql(dbConnApp, sqlStmt.ToString, True) End Using
'OPFAC_For_All_Billets = String.Join(" |,", dt.ToString) Return dt #End Region
Catch ex As Exception Throw ErrorHandler.LogWrite(si, New XFException(si, ex)) End Try End Function
Public Function GetMaxCommentNbr(ByVal si As SessionInfo, ByVal api As FinanceRulesApi, ByVal wfCube As String, ByVal wfTime As String, ByVal wfScenario As String, ByVal wfProfile As String, ByVal RPAppr As String, ByVal RPName As String, ByVal RPEntity As String) As String 'api - wfCube - wfTime - wfScenario - wfProfile - RPAppr - RPName - RPEntity Try #Region "GetMaxCommentNbr"
Dim SetAnnotationScriptGenerics As String = "A#StaffSymbol_ConcReview:V#Annotation:F#" & RPName & ":O#Forms:I#None:U1#None:U2#None:U3#None:U4#None:U5#None:U6#None:U7#None" Dim SetPeriodicScriptGenerics As String = "A#StaffSymbol_ConcReview:V#Periodic:F#" & RPName & ":O#Forms:I#None:U1#None:U2#None:U3#None:U4#None:U5#None:U6#None:U7#None"
Dim NextCommentNbr As String = String.Empty Dim maxCommentScriptGenerics As String = "E#" & RPEntity & ":S#" & wfScenario & ":T#" & wfTime & ":A#StaffSymbol_ConcReview:V#Annotation:F#" & RPName & ":C#Local:O#Forms:I#None:U1#None:U2#None:U3#None:U4#None:U5#None:U6#None:U7#None" Dim dimPk As DimPk = BRApi.Finance.Dim.GetDimPk(si, "Std_Reporting") Dim mbrId As Integer = BRApi.Finance.Members.GetMemberId(si, dimTypeId.UD8, "Total_Comments") Dim totalCommentsCnt As Integer = BRApi.Finance.Members.GetChildren(si, dimPk, mbrId,).Count Dim commentNbr As New Integer 'Added "E#" & RPEntity & Dim bufferMbrScript As String = "E#" & RPEntity & ":" & "A#StaffSymbol_ConcReview:F#" & RPName & ":O#Forms:I#None:U1#None:U2#None:U3#None:U4#None:U5#None:U6#None:U7#None" Dim startingBuffer As DataBuffer = api.Data.GetDataBufferUsingFormula("FilterMembers(" & bufferMbrScript & ", U8#Total_Comments.Base)") 'startingBuffer.LogDataBuffer(api, "startingBuffer " & DateTime.Now.Millisecond , 50)
Dim comment As String = String.Empty Dim symbol As String = String.Empty Dim existingComments As New List(Of String) Dim maxComment As Int16 =0 If Not startingBuffer Is Nothing Then Dim i As New Integer For Each startingCell As DataBufferCell In startingBuffer.DataBufferCells.Values If Not startingCell.CellStatus.IsNoData AndAlso startingCell.CellAmount<>0 Then comment = startingCell.GetUD8Name(api) If CInt(Right(comment,2))>maxComment Then maxComment = CInt(Right(comment,2)) End If symbol = api.Data.GetDataCellEx(maxCommentScriptGenerics & ":UD8#" & comment).DataCellAnnotation existingComments.Add(symbol) End If i+=1 Next End If
'BRApi.ErrorLog.LogMessage(si, "existingComments--string.Join=" + String.Join(",", existingComments)) maxComment = maxComment + 1 'add the new comment row for the new symbol (since it does not exist) If maxComment < 10 Then Return "0" & maxComment Else Return maxComment End If Return Nothing #End Region
Catch ex As Exception Throw ErrorHandler.LogWrite(si, New XFException(si, ex)) End Try End Function
